notes: Hardened app startup so the app can no longer close immediately on any device.
The floating pen service is now crash-safe and stops cleanly when you close the app.
Added a crash log (Settings → Troubleshooting) that records the exact error if anything ever fails — so we can fix it instantly.
Android downloads use versioned file names, so you always get the newest APK.
The app fits every phone screen, with a back button and Android back-key navigation.
Only one floating pen, and the quick-capture window follows the pen wherever you drag it.
